chose: A host line quotes a play when it repeats five words in a row of any matched play's text, counted case and punctuation aside (QUOTE_RUN = 5). An essay holds at most 16 games and 120 bites (GAMES_MOST, BITES_MOST).
options: Five words in a row (chosen): four ('at the CHI 45') are how anyone says where a ball is; five in a row of ESPN's sentence is its sentence.
Four words: refuses ordinary football words the host needs ('fourth and five at').
Any shared phrase over a similarity score: a number nobody can read off a refusal.
gray: Where saying a moment ends and quoting ESPN's play text begins is a judgement no check settles; the owner hears it in the host's lines.
undo: Move QUOTE_RUN, GAMES_MOST or BITES_MOST in packages/video-render/src/game-essay.ts, with a call that moves this one.
